mapper.select:
select et.id, et.code, et.name, et.enabled, count(distinct e.id) as equipment_count, count(distinct ii.id) as inspection_item_count, et.created_at from equipment_type et left join equipment e on e.equipment_type_id = et.id left join inspection_item ii on ii.equipment_type_id = et.id
and ( et.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or et.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and et.enabled = #{enabled}
group by et.id, et.code, et.name, et.enabled, et.created_at
order by et.created_at desc, et.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into equipment_type ( code, name, description, enabled ) values ( #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled} )
mapper.select:
select id, code, name from equipment_type where enabled = 1
and ( code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by name, id

select et.id, et.code, et.name, et.description, et.enabled, count(distinct e.id) as equipment_count, count(distinct ii.id) as inspection_item_count, et.created_at, et.updated_at from equipment_type et left join equipment e on e.equipment_type_id = et.id left join inspection_item ii on ii.equipment_type_id = et.id where et.id = #{equipmentTypeId} group by et.id, et.code, et.name, et.description, et.enabled, et.created_at, et.updated_at
select count(*) from equipment where equipment_type_id = #{equipmentTypeId} and status != 'DISABLED'
